sentence: This project uses mice to study how disrupting a receptor changes the way the medial prefrontal cortex and the insular cortex interact.
This project builds machine-learning tools that explain protein data measured by mass spectrometry.
This project tests whether tighter blood pressure control protects the heart from harm caused by breast cancer treatment in patients.
This project studies how a cell pathway spots proteins to break down and builds tools to control that pathway.
This project builds materials that can be injected or printed layer by layer into vocal fold wounds to help the tissue heal.
This project studies how risk genes act in human stem cell models of brain development and function.
This project studies how cancers develop and spread, and how tumors and host responses affect patient survival.
This project studies prostate cancer screening in older men and builds a tool that predicts the risk of aggressive cancer.
This project tests an imaging method that measures the shape, blood flow and metabolism of brain tumors together.
This project studies how body fat and muscle, inflammation and immunity affect treatment and outcomes in patients with non-muscle invasive bladder cancer.
This project studies how signaling between cells controls cell fate as tissues renew and stay healthy.
This project studies signaling pathways that lead to the loss of neurons and myelin-producing cells in neurodegenerative diseases, using animal models.
This project develops nano-formulations that switch on an immune response against head and neck cancer.
This project studies which men develop each molecular subtype of prostate cancer and what risk factors are linked to each subtype.
This project supports research on HIV in basic, clinical and behavioral areas, with the goal of ending the HIV epidemic.
This project studies atypical forms of diabetes that fit neither common type, using genome sequencing and other tests to find their causes.
This project builds AI tools that predict a person's genetic risk of cancer and studies the ethical, social and legal effects of using them.
This project tests whether cells around brain capillaries have special channels that let them sense hypoxia and control blood flow.
This project studies how where people live, smoking and biological changes are linked to lung cancer risk in adults.
This project builds genetic tools to find and test how HIV proteins interact with host proteins in primary human T cells.
